blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find each indefinite integral. (Check answer by differentiating.) \(\int (1 + 2t)\,dt\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh seedha sa polynomial hai jis ka variable \(t\) hai, aur \(dt\) bata raha hai ke integration \(t\) ke saath hogi.
Sawal do kaam keh raha hai: pehle integral nikalo, phir differentiate kar ke check karo.
Rules: Rule 2 se terms alag, Rule 1 se constant bahar, Rule 3 (Power Rule) se \(t\) ka integral.
Plan: term by term integrate, ek constant \(c\), aur aakhir mein tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int (1 + 2t)\,dt\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral, aur phir usay differentiate kar ke check karna.
Tareeqa: Rule 2 (term by term), Rule 1 (constant bahar), Rule 3 (Power Rule).

Term by term integrate karein
\[\int (1 + 2t)\,dt = \int 1\,dt + 2\int t\,dt\]
\[= t + 2\cdot\dfrac{t^2}{2} + c\]
\[= t + t^2 + c\]
Kyun: \(\int 1\,dt = t\), kyunke \(t\) ka derivative 1 hai. \(t\) ki power 1 hai, Power Rule se power 2 ho gayi aur 2 se divide kiya: \(\frac{t^2}{2}\). Phir 2 aur 2 cancel ho gaye.

Differentiate kar ke tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}\left(t + t^2 + c\right) = 1 + 2t \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Integration aur differentiation ek doosre ke ulte hain. Jawab ka derivative wapas integrand (\(1 + 2t\)) de raha hai, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find each indefinite integral. (Check answer by differentiating.) \(\int (3u^2 + 4u)\,du\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi polynomial hai, lekin is dafa variable \(u\) hai kyunke aakhir mein \(du\) likha hai. Letter badalne se rules nahi badalte.
Do terms hain: \(3u^2\) aur \(4u\). Har ek par Power Rule lagega.
Plan: term by term integrate, ek constant, phir differentiate kar ke check.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int (3u^2 + 4u)\,du\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral aur us ki tasdeeq.
Tareeqa: Rule 1, 2 aur 3, variable \(u\) ke saath.

Term by term integrate karein
\[\int (3u^2 + 4u)\,du = 3\cdot\dfrac{u^3}{3} + 4\cdot\dfrac{u^2}{2} + c\]
\[= u^3 + 2u^2 + c\]
Kyun: \(u^2\) ki power 2 se 3 hui aur 3 se divide; \(u\) ki power 1 se 2 hui aur 2 se divide. Phir \(3 \div 3 = 1\) aur \(4 \div 2 = 2\), is liye jawab saaf aur chhota ho gaya.

Differentiate kar ke tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{du}\left(u^3 + 2u^2 + c\right) = 3u^2 + 4u \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(u^3\) ka derivative \(3u^2\) aur \(2u^2\) ka \(4u\). Integrand wapas mil gaya, matlab kaam sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find each indefinite integral. (Check answer by differentiating.) \(\int 100x^8\,dx\)
blocks.explanation:
Is mein sirf ek term hai: constant 100 aur \(x\) ki power 8.
Rule 1 se 100 bahar, phir Power Rule \(n = 8\) ke saath.
Plan: integrate karein, fraction ko waise hi rehne dein, aur differentiate kar ke check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int 100x^8\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral aur tasdeeq.
Tareeqa: Rule 1 aur Rule 3.

Rule 1 aur Power Rule lagayein
\[\int 100x^8\,dx = 100\cdot\dfrac{x^{8+1}}{8+1} + c\]
\[= \dfrac{100}{9}x^9 + c\]
Kyun: Power mein 1 jama kiya (8 se 9) aur nayi power 9 se divide kiya. 100 ko 9 se poora divide nahi kar sakte, is liye \(\frac{100}{9}\) fraction hi rahega; isay decimal mein badalne ki zaroorat nahi.

Differentiate kar ke tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{100}{9}x^9 + c\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{100}{9}\cdot 9x^8 = 100x^8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Differentiate karte waqt power 9 neeche aati hai aur denominator wale 9 ko cancel kar deti hai. Integrand \(100x^8\) wapas mil gaya.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Find each indefinite integral. (Check answer by differentiating.) \(\int \left(2x^{-2} + 3x^{-3}\right)dx\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(x\) ki powers negative hain: \(-2\) aur \(-3\). Bohat se students yahan ghabra jate hain, lekin Power Rule sirf \(n = -1\) par kaam nahi karta; baqi har power par chalta hai.
Do terms hain, dono par Power Rule lagega.
Plan: integrate karein, jawab ko positive powers mein likhein (fraction ki shakal), phir differentiate kar ke check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \left(2x^{-2} + 3x^{-3}\right)dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral aur tasdeeq.
Tareeqa: Rule 1, 2 aur 3, jahan \(n = -2\) aur \(n = -3\).

Term by term integrate karein
\[= 2\cdot\dfrac{x^{-1}}{-1} + 3\cdot\dfrac{x^{-2}}{-2} + c\]
\[= -2x^{-1} - \dfrac{3}{2}x^{-2} + c\]
Kyun: \(-2\) mein 1 jama karein to \(-1\) banta hai, aur \(-3\) mein 1 jama karein to \(-2\). Phir inhi nayi powers se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: negative number mein 1 jama karne se woh zero ki taraf aata hai: \(-3 + 1 = -2\), \(-4\) nahi. Yeh ghalti aksar hoti hai.

Positive powers mein likhein
\[= -\dfrac{2}{x} - \dfrac{3}{2x^2} + c\]
Kyun: \(x^{-1} = \frac{1}{x}\) aur \(x^{-2} = \frac{1}{x^2}\). Jawab ko fraction ki shakal mein likhna zyada saaf hai aur answer key se milana aasaan hai.

Differentiate kar ke tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(-2x^{-1} - \tfrac{3}{2}x^{-2}\right)\]
\[= 2x^{-2} + 3x^{-3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-2 \times (-1) = 2\) aur \(-\frac{3}{2} \times (-2) = 3\); powers wapas \(-2\) aur \(-3\) ho gayin. Integrand wapas mil gaya.
